creators.name: Gilles Pudlowski
creators.following: One of France's most-read national restaurant critics (ex-Le Point, author of the Pudlo guides); decades-long track record.
creators.why: Authoritative, verifiably-prominent French food critic; his named reviews of Brasserie Le 11 (Metz), Chez Tanesy (Nancy), Boulangerie Dudot (Metz) and Le Manoir du Soldat/An II (Phalsbourg) are specific, findable pieces used as a strong source.
